headline.purpose: The single hero figure on a screen (e.g. P&L value). One per region.

title.purpose: Ticker symbols and primary identifiers; heaviest weight, used sparingly.

body.purpose: Default UI text and data-table cells at 13px.

label.purpose: Uppercase column headers and KPI labels; ≤4 words only.

mono.purpose: Compact data pills (score, sub-scores) in tabular monospace.

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: Near-invisible resting seam; tonal contrast carries most depth.

shadows.name: glow-accent
shadows.purpose: Focus / active-state response; never a resting decoration.

motion.name: ease-state
motion.purpose: Default state transitions (0.15–0.2s) on color, border, background.

motion.name: lift
motion.purpose: Action buttons translate up 1px on hover.

motion.name: bar-fill
motion.purpose: KPI bar fills animate width on data change.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent-blue, #5B8AFF); color: #fff; padding: 0.6rem 1.2rem; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-blue-soft, rgba(91,138,255,0.16)); }

components.name: Trade Action Button
components.description: The single most consequential action; the one sanctioned gradient.
components.css: .ds-btn-trade { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(74,122,255,0.28), rgba(139,92,246,0.22)); border: 1px solid rgba(74,122,255,0.55); color: #DCE6FF; padding: 0.55rem 1rem; border-radius: var(--radius-pill, 9999px); font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(74,122,255,0.10), 0 6px 18px -8px rgba(74,122,255,0.55); transition: transform 0.18s ease, box-shadow 0.18s ease, background 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-trade:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(74,122,255,0.38), rgba(139,92,246,0.30)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(74,122,255,0.20), 0 10px 26px -8px rgba(74,122,255,0.70); }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Link
components.description: Quiet at rest, confidently lit when active.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 220px; } .ds-nav-link { width: 100%; padding: 0.5rem 0.85rem; color: var(--text-muted, #9AA1B2); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.8rem; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); background: transparent; text-align: left; transition: background-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--text-main, #E8EAF0); background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); } .ds-nav-link.active { color: #fff; background-color: var(--accent-blue-soft, rgba(91,138,255,0.16)); border-color: rgba(74,122,255,0.40); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(74,122,255,0.10), 0 4px 16px -4px rgba(91,138,255,0.35); }

components.name: Score Pill
components.description: Compact monospace data pill; semantic color variants.
components.css: .ds-score-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 18px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--border-color, #2F3447); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); color: var(--text-muted, #9AA1B2); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-score-pill strong { color: var(--text-main, #E8EAF0); font-size: 11px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-score-pill--visual { border-color: rgba(88,166,255,0.48); background: rgba(88,166,255,0.09); color: #58a6ff; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Status with embedded dot; tinted background of its own hue.
components.css: .ds-status-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; border: 1px solid transparent; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status-pill .dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-status-pill.win { background: var(--success-bg, rgba(61,211,122,0.14)); color: var(--success, #3DD37A); border-color: rgba(34,197,94,0.30); } .ds-status-pill.win .dot { background: var(--success, #3DD37A); box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--success, #3DD37A); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Hairline field that shifts to Signal Blue with a soft ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { padding: 0.5rem; background: var(--bg-panel, #232735); border: 1px solid var(--border-color, #2F3447); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); color: var(--text-main, #E8EAF0); font-family: inherit; font-size: 13px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-faint, #6C7488); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent-blue, #5B8AFF); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-blue-soft, rgba(91,138,255,0.16)); }

components.name: Screener Card Header
components.description: The dense triage unit: watchlist + considered toggles, tier-colored ticker, score.
components.html: NVDAAScore 87
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--bg-panel, #232735); border: 1px solid var(--border-color, #2F3447); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); overflow: hidden; transition: border-color 0.16s ease, background 0.16s ease; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(91,138,255,0.58); background: #242837; } .ds-card-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 8px; background: rgba(20,23,33,0.98); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.055); } .ds-icon-toggle { width: 22px; height: 22px; border: 1px solid var(--border-color, #2F3447); border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #6b6b7a; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1; } .ds-ticker { color: #BB86FC; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 850; line-height: 1; } .ds-tier { color: var(--text-muted, #9AA1B2); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-score { margin-left: auto; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-main, #E8EAF0); }

narrative.overview: Chrollo is a pro's cockpit for reading market structure. The surface stays dark and quiet so it can be stared at for hours, but the hierarchy is confident: every screen commits to the one reading that matters most, and every control and number sits exactly where a returning user expects it. Depth comes from a calibrated ramp of dark slate surfaces, not from drop shadows or glass. Color is spent deliberately — a single interactive blue, a small set of categorical accents, and a reserved tier palette that carries product meaning. Numbers are the protagonists, set in tabular figures that hold their columns and never jitter.
keyCharacteristics: Dark 'warm slate' surface ramp; depth by tone, not shadow.
One interactive accent (blue); accents otherwise categorical and rare.
Reserved tier palette (S/A/B/C) that means something, used nowhere else.
Tabular numerics everywhere; data alignment is non-negotiable.
Tactile, confident controls that come alive on interaction.

rules.name: The One-Accent Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue (#5B8AFF) is the only interactivity color. Violet, rose, and gold are categorical labels, not buttons. Blue stays scarce enough to remain a signal.

rules.name: The Tier-Reserve Rule
rules.body: The S/A/B/C tier hues are reserved for tier identity. Never borrow tier amber or tier violet for decoration, charts, or accents.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Columns must align and digits must not reflow as values update.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Family Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is built from Inter's weight range, not from adding typefaces. Do not introduce a serif or a second sans for emphasis; go heavier or larger.

rules.name: The Tonal-Depth Rule
rules.body: Reach for the next surface step before reaching for a shadow. If two flat surfaces need separation, change the tone or add a hairline border.

rules.name: The Glow-On-State Rule
rules.body: Glow and elevated shadow appear in response to hover, focus, or float (modals). A surface that glows at rest is over-designed; remove it.

dos: Do convey depth with the surface ramp and hairline borders before reaching for a shadow.
Do set every changeable number in tabular-nums so columns align.
Do keep Signal Blue as the sole interactivity color; build hierarchy with Inter's weight range.
Do reserve the S/A/B/C tier hues for tier identity and nothing else.
Do let controls be confident on interaction — a clear lift, tint, border, or focus ring.
donts: Don't add gamified-broker mechanics: no confetti, no celebratory win animation, no oversized green P&L designed to feel good.
Don't ship the generic-SaaS look: no endless identical card grids, no gradient hero-metric tiles, no uppercase eyebrow kicker above every section.
Don't over-design: no decorative glassmorphism, no heavy/showy motion, no ornamental gradients between the trader and the data.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text on a gradient); the current .brand-text is a legacy exception slated for cleanup.
Don't borrow a tier or categorical accent to mean 'clickable' — that role belongs to Signal Blue alone.
Don't let a surface glow at rest; glow and elevated shadow are state responses only.
